Abbas Araghchi, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, in an interview with the Iraqi television network "Al-Akhbariya," criticized the United States' conduct in diplomatic processes and stated that Tehran has entered into negotiations with the American side three times, but all three rounds of these talks ended in military confrontation and war. Emphasizing that these attacks occurred precisely in the middle of negotiations, Araghchi announced that it has been definitively proven to Tehran that no trust whatsoever can be placed in Washington at the negotiating table. He also said that although in the third round of talks they had reached a mutual understanding with Trump, the American president did not remain loyal to his pledge and his commitments lasted only two weeks, which has caused the Islamic Republic of Iran's trust in the American side to drop to zero.@VahidOOnLineMasoud Pezeshkian, in a meeting with Asim Munir, the Commander of the Pakistan Army, said: "All the problems in the region, from escalating tensions to disruption in the Strait of Hormuz, stem from America's warmongering nature. The Americans must answer why they essentially started a war and dragged themselves and the world into trouble and predicament."Pezeshkian added: "We know that war is neither in our interest, nor in the interest of the region and the world, nor even in America's interest. For any negotiations, they must first remove pressures, threats, and sanctions."He said: "Our nation today does not trust America and believes that if we negotiate, they will attack us again. They constantly propagandize in the media that they want to attack our country to frighten our people, while our nation has no fear of martyrdom."Pezeshkian, addressing the Commander of the Pakistan Army, added: "You, as our Muslim brothers, must make them understand that this is not how one treats Muslims. We do not want to impose our will on anyone, but we will not bow to force."@VahidOOnLine📡 @VahidOnline

entry.title: [VahidOnline] The Hrana News Agency reported that Homayoun Shabankareh, a 22-year-old citizen…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @VahidOnline

The Hrana News Agency reported that Homayoun Shabankareh, a 22-year-old citizen held in the Central Penitentiary of Karaj, has been sentenced to death by Branch 2 of the Karaj Revolutionary Court on charges of moharebeh and espionage. According to Hrana, a source close to Shabankareh's family said his death sentence was communicated to him on Saturday, 25 Mehr. His case was heard in Branch 2 of the Karaj Revolutionary Court, presided over by Mehdi Sabzevarnejad, known as "Sabzevari," and Mehdi Razavi has also been named as another judge connected to the case. According to published information, Shabankareh was arrested on 24 Ordibehesht 1405 at his home in connection with security developments stemming from military conflicts. Agents attributed to the Intelligence Organization of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps searched the house for about three hours, confiscated a number of his personal belongings, including his laptop, and transferred him to the Central Penitentiary of Karaj. After his arrest, Shabankareh was held for 97 days in solitary confinement in Ward 12 of the prison, and after the interrogation phase ended, he was transferred to the general ward for only 12 days. From 8 Shahrivar to 8 Mehr, he was once again held in solitary confinement and went on hunger strike during this period. Hrana also reported that he had a history of a suicide attempt during his time in solitary confinement.@VahidOOnLine📡 @VahidOnline
